version_history.1.0: Initial release: ebook, learning, lecture, essay, newsletter, magazine, presentation, publication.
version_history.1.1: Added course, lms-package, workbook, journal-issue, guided-journal, social-calendar, proposal, journal-article(+claude), thesis(+claude). Added shared engines: course-architecture, lms-packaging, workbook, journal-academic, journal-personal, social-calendar, proposal, academic-citation, thesis-structure. Added config/platform_notes.md for cross-platform output handling.
version_history.1.2: Added compulsory Academic Integrity Engine (similarity, fake/fraudulent citations, misrepresentation, unconfirmed facts, broken links) and Editorial Naturalness Engine (default prose-quality standard, never a detection-evasion feature). Added graphics-brief, audio-music, video, tutorial, documentation commands and their engines. Added config/tool_categories.md (generic, unbranded tool-category guidance).
version_history.1.3: Added blog-post factory (five selectable post types, standard SEO section, optional pillar+supporting-post series mode). Independent from the Social Calendar Engine by design. Added engines/blog-post-engine.md.
version_history.1.4: Added email-campaign, landing-page, and web-app-blueprint factories, identified via a research pass against standard content-marketing taxonomies. web-app-blueprint is structurally distinct from other factories: it produces prompts/specs/step-by-step instructions for external AI app-builder, version-control, and deployment tools rather than a content artifact, and states this scope explicitly to the user. Added engines: email-marketing, landing-page, web-app-factory. Expanded config/tool_categories.md with email, website-builder, and app-build/deployment tool categories.
version_history.1.5: Added cv-portfolio factory: selectable CV formats (academic, institutional leadership, professional/corporate, extensible), job-advert-tailored application packages, and a portfolio track (website and/or document). Default track for senior institutional vacancies models the Provost/Deputy Provost-level application pattern already in use for prior clients. Added engines/cv-portfolio-engine.md.
version_history.1.6: Expanded cv-portfolio factory's format list beyond academic/institutional-leadership/professional to seven selectable formats (added chronological, functional, combination/hybrid, executive, entry-level/graduate résumés). Added 11 blank-skeleton templates in templates/ (one per CV/résumé format, plus cover_letter, vision_statement, referee_list, portfolio_document), matching the existing template style used elsewhere in the skill. No command file added — same /create-cv-portfolio command, wider format coverage.
version_history.1.7: Build closed at 30 modes. Press release/media statement wired into the existing /create-publication router as option 8, with a dedicated news-writing structure and discipline section, rather than as a new command. Added speech (Speech, Keynote & Convocation Address factory) as the 30th and final standalone mode. Added engines/speech-engine.md.
